description.zh: 仙女座超市大促销，走过路过不要错过！-你被抽中参加超市慈善抽奖。
description.en: The Andromeda Supermarket is running a galaxy-sized promotion. Step right up—you have been picked for its charity lucky draw!

text.zh: 试试运气：把手伸进抽奖箱
text.en: Try your luck: reach into the raffle box

result.zh: 你运气爆棚,一举抽中了头奖！
result.en: Jackpot! Against all reasonable odds, you have won first prize.

text.zh: 奖品什么的才不关心呢：放弃抽奖
text.en: Who needs prizes? Skip the lucky draw

result.zh: 仙女座超市邀请你担任荣誉吉祥物。
result.en: The Andromeda Supermarket invites you to become its honorary mascot.

description.zh: 一颗美食星球开放免费自助餐，仅供碳基生物参加。
description.en: A planet famed for its cuisine is offering a free buffet—carbon-based lifeforms only.

text.zh: 把盘子装满
text.en: Fill your plate

result.zh: 谁说没有免费的午餐？
result.en: Who said there was no such thing as a free lunch?

text.zh: 小口品尝并感谢厨师
text.en: Taste politely and thank the chef

result.zh: 后厨窗口伸出了一只腕足，握手的触感让你想起深不见底的大海。
result.en: A tentacle reaches out from the kitchen window to shake your hand. Its touch reminds you of the ocean’s darkest depths.

description.zh: 全银河直播的选秀正在招募选手，报名条件是能发出声音-录音除外。
description.en: A galaxy-wide talent show is recruiting contestants. The only requirement: make a sound. Recordings do not count.

text.zh: 你从不错过表现的机会-上台表演
text.en: Never one to miss the spotlight—get on stage

result.zh: 评委称你的表演为后现代宇宙尖叫艺术。
result.en: The judges call your act postmodern cosmic scream art.

text.zh: 沉默是你的本能-坐在第一排鼓掌
text.en: Silence is your nature—applaud from the front row

result.zh: 你简直是节奏大王！-鼓掌的节奏被制作成节目主题曲。
result.en: What a master of rhythm! Your applause becomes the show’s theme song.

description.zh: 你发现一颗布满温泉的星球，泉水据说可以修复任何长途旅行造成的疲惫。
description.en: You discover a planet of hot springs said to cure every inconvenience of long-distance travel.

text.zh: 享受温泉
text.en: Take a long soak

result.zh: 你觉得焕然一新。
result.en: You feel like a brand-new lifeform.

text.zh: 潜入温泉底部
text.en: Dive to the bottom of the hot spring

result.zh: 你发现了一种全新物种，它们能发出“阿瓜阿瓜”的声音。
result.en: You discover an entirely new species. Its members communicate by shouting “Agua, agua!”

description.zh: 近日，空间站失物招领处宣布无人认领的包裹可以免费领走。
description.en: The space station’s lost-and-found has just announced that unclaimed parcels are free for the taking.

text.zh: 趁机捞一把-挑走最闪亮的包裹
text.en: Make the most of it—take the shiniest parcel

result.zh: 果然物超所值，但你总感觉耳边隐隐传来某人的怨念。
result.en: Quite the bargain. Still, you can almost hear a stranger grumbling in your ear.

text.zh: 还是算了吧-帮助寻找失主
text.en: Better not—help find the rightful owner

result.zh: 今年的“星际好公民”奖非你莫属！
result.en: This year’s Interstellar Good Citizen Award has your name written all over it.

description.zh: 某个文明正庆祝欢迎所有外来者的节日，向你递上了一顶花环。
description.en: A friendly civilisation celebrates visitors and offers you a ceremonial wreath.

text.zh: 加入欢迎仪式
text.en: Join the ceremony

result.zh: 欢迎舞蹈一共十四小时，这颗星球上的所有人都记住了你的舞步。
result.en: The welcome dance lasts fourteen hours. By the end, everyone on the planet knows your moves.

text.zh: 学习他们的语言
text.en: Learn their language

result.zh: 经过3个小时，你学会了他们的第一句问候语：“请勿食用月亮。”
result.en: After three hours, you master your first local greeting: “Please do not eat the moon.”

description.zh: 导航系统发现一条新路线，上面写着“绝对安全（大概）”。
description.en: Your navigator discovers a new route labelled “Absolutely Safe (Probably).”

text.zh: 走捷径
text.en: Take the shortcut

result.zh: 你提前2分钟抵达了目的地，足够一些文明进行一万次演化呢！
result.en: You arrive two minutes early—enough time for some civilisations to evolve ten thousand times over!

text.zh: 记录新航路
text.en: Document the route

result.zh: 你向星际导航APP提交了新路线，标题叫“可能是路”。
result.en: You submit the route to an interstellar navigation app under the title “Possibly a Road.”

description.zh: 路边自动售货机掉出一块饼干，上面写着“今天我会被吃掉”。
description.en: A vending machine drops a fortune cookie that reads: “Today, I will be eaten.”

text.zh: 相信它的预言-直接吃掉饼干
text.en: Trust the prophecy—eat the cookie

result.zh: 饼干预言自己会被吃掉。结果正确，准确率百分之百。
result.en: The cookie predicts it will be eaten. Its accuracy is now 100%.

text.zh: 分析它的预测模型
text.en: Analyse the model

result.zh: 你发现所谓预测模型只是一张便利贴。
result.en: The prediction model turns out to be a sticky note.

description.zh: 你来到 K8 酒馆，机械服务生递来一张无法读懂的酒水单。
description.en: At K8 Space Bar, a robot waiter presents a menu written in an impossible alphabet.

text.zh: 点一杯普通饮料-谨慎是星际旅行的保命法则
text.en: Order an ordinary drink—caution keeps a space traveller alive

result.zh: 这杯饮料没有试图与你交谈，已经是重大进步。
result.en: Your drink does not try to talk to you. A wonderful start.

text.zh: 试试今日特调
text.en: Try the house special

result.zh: 你看见了第四种基色，可惜回家后完全讲不清。
result.en: You see a fourth primary colour. Explaining it later proves difficult.

text.zh: 每种都来一杯
text.en: Order everything

result.zh: 全酒馆为你欢呼，包括医务室。
result.en: The entire bar cheers you on, including the medical bay.

description.zh: 一块陨石路过，请求你帮它纠正宇宙学家对其出生地的错误描述。
description.en: A passing meteorite asks you to correct cosmologists’ wildly inaccurate account of where it was born.

text.zh: 认真和它交朋友
text.en: Make friends with it

result.zh: 陨石称你是“唯一懂石头情绪的人”。
result.en: The rock calls you the only person who understands mineral feelings.

text.zh: 牵头成立“陨石保护协会”
text.en: Lead the campaign to establish the Meteorite Protection Society

result.zh: 陨石的命也是命！
result.en: Meteorite lives matter, too!

description.zh: 叩叩！一位推销员向你赠送可返回昨天的八折优惠券。
description.en: Knock, knock! A salesperson hands you a 20%-off coupon for a trip back to yesterday.

text.zh: 立刻使用
text.en: Use it immediately

result.zh: 你成功回到了过去，却发现余额没有一起重返昨天。
result.en: You make it back to yesterday. Sadly, your bank balance does not.

text.zh: 把优惠券转售
text.en: Resell the coupon

result.zh: 由于倒卖行为，你被公示惩罚三个月
result.en: For reselling the coupon, you are publicly penalised for the next three months.

description.zh: 一颗行星邀请你公开讨论“太阳是不是只是比较大的台灯”。
description.en: A planet invites you to publicly debate whether the sun is just a rather large desk lamp.

text.zh: 坚持科学解释-如果你认为核聚变和灯泡是一样的话…
text.en: Defend science—unless you think nuclear fusion and a light bulb are the same thing…

result.zh: 你说服了评委，却没说服现场的十二万盏灯。
result.en: You convince the judges, but not the 120,000 lamps in attendance.

text.zh: 迎合观众-太阳是烧煤油的！
text.en: Tell the crowd what it wants to hear—the sun runs on kerosene!

result.zh: 观众高喊你的名字，太阳拒绝发表评论。
result.en: The crowd chants your name. The sun declines to comment.

description.zh: 一台机器人正在思考自己究竟是不是微波炉。
description.en: A robot philosopher wonders whether it is secretly a microwave.

text.zh: 是或不是，这是个问题-进行辩论
text.en: To be or not to be—enter the debate

result.zh: 辩论持续十小时，你承认还是机器人的大脑比较好用。
result.en: After ten hours of debate, you admit the robot has the more useful brain.

text.zh: 微波炉可没有幽默感-教它讲笑话
text.en: Microwaves have no sense of humour—teach it a joke

result.zh: 它讲的第一个笑话是“人类”。
result.en: Its very first joke is “humanity.”

description.zh: 三颗卫星决定结婚，整个星系都在争论谁该坐主桌。
description.en: Three moons decide to get married. The entire star system is arguing over who gets to sit at the head table.

text.zh: 让我试试
text.en: Let me handle this

result.zh: 经过长达87年的讨论，你最终被指定为第二颗卫星的证婚人。
result.en: After eighty-seven years of discussion, you are finally appointed the second moon’s wedding witness.

text.zh: 应该搞个大圆桌
text.en: Why not use one enormous round table?

result.zh: 这样所有人都坐得下了，宇宙和平
result.en: At last, everyone has a seat. Peace returns to the cosmos.

description.zh: 星际集市声称这里的每件商品都“至少来自某个时代”。
description.en: A flea market guarantees every item is from “at least one point in time”.

text.zh: 买一件来历不明的东西
text.en: Buy the mysterious object

result.zh: 你买到一只杯子，它坚称自己是宇宙皇帝。
result.en: You buy a mug that insists it is emperor of the universe.

text.zh: 精挑细选后决定什么也不买
text.en: After careful consideration, buy absolutely nothing

result.zh: 众人惊呼：“你竟然看出了这是场骗局！”
result.en: The crowd gasps: “You mean you spotted the scam?!”

description.zh: 一个广播频道邀请你分享太空旅行经历，形式是当下最流行的一对一访谈。
description.en: A radio station invites you to talk about your travels in the latest craze: a one-on-one interview.

text.zh: 接受采访
text.en: Go on air

result.zh: 你说的话被剪辑成二十四小时循环的宇宙励志节目。
result.en: Your words become a 24-hour motivational broadcast.

text.zh: 拒绝出镜
text.en: Decline the interview

result.zh: 主持人表示完全理解，却留下了一串失望的杂音。
result.en: The host says they understand, then leaves behind a string of disappointed static.

description.zh: 一条未经许可的虫洞出现在你面前，入口贴着“安全第一”的手写便签。
description.en: An unlicensed wormhole appears with a handwritten sign: “Safety First”.

text.zh: 接受挑战是冒险者的游戏-穿过虫洞
text.en: Challenges are what adventurers live for—enter the wormhole

result.zh: 你平安抵达目的地，连鞋带都没有乱。
result.en: You emerge unharmed, not even a shoelace displaced.

result.zh: 你差点被折成二维生物。
result.en: You nearly get folded into a two-dimensional lifeform.

text.zh: 放弃也是一种智慧-绕路离开
text.en: Knowing when to quit is wisdom—take the long way around

result.zh: 你平安离开，两个月后听说了一些失踪事件……
result.en: You leave unharmed. Two months later, you begin hearing reports of mysterious disappearances…

description.zh: 你意外受伤了，最近边陲诊所的告示牌上写着“许可证正在申请中，大概率成功”。医生的八只手都举起了大拇指。
description.en: You have been injured. A clinic on the frontier displays a sign reading “Licence application pending—approval highly likely.” All eight of the doctor’s hands are giving you a thumbs-up.

text.zh: 死马当活马医-接受治疗
text.en: Desperate times—accept the treatment

result.zh: 手术很成功！如果忽视那些洗不掉的粘液的话。
result.en: The surgery is a success! Provided you overlook the slime that will not wash off.

result.zh: 果然是庸医！医生表示并发症是“体验的一部分”。
result.en: What a quack! The doctor insists that complications are “part of the experience.”

text.zh: 我选择宇宙救护车-礼貌离开
text.en: I’ll take the space ambulance instead—leave politely

result.zh: 你保留了所有原厂零件。
result.en: You leave with all your original parts.

description.zh: 某个外星投资顾问向你保证：只要投钱，财富就会以光速增长。
description.en: An alien investment adviser assures you that your wealth will grow at the speed of light—as long as you put money in.

text.zh: 全部梭哈
text.en: Go all in

result.zh: 这次居然赚到了，连骗子都目瞪口呆。
result.en: You somehow make a profit. Even the scammer looks shocked.

result.zh: 你的投资被转化为一颗名为“教训”的小行星。
result.en: Your investment becomes an asteroid named “Lesson”.

text.zh: 举报诈骗
text.en: Report the scheme

result.zh: 监管部门感谢你，并表示调查预计于三个世纪后完成。
result.en: Regulators thank you. The investigation will finish in three centuries.

description.zh: 一个追债人声称你欠了上一辈子的停车费。
description.en: A collector claims you owe parking fees from a previous incarnation.

text.zh: 装作认识对方
text.en: Pretend to know them

result.zh: 你们热烈拥抱，对方忘了自己为什么来。
result.en: You embrace. They forget why they came.

text.zh: 认真解释
text.en: Argue your case

result.zh: 你赢了逻辑辩论，却输了星际论坛的舆论战。
result.en: You win the argument and lose the comment section.

description.zh: 一台服务机器人暴走，疯狂要求所有旅客填写满意度调查。
description.en: A service robot goes rogue, forcing everyone to fill out a satisfaction survey.

text.zh: 尝试修理它
text.en: Try to repair it

result.zh: 你修好了它，机器人给你打了五星好评。
result.en: You repair it. The robot leaves you a five-star review.

result.zh: 机器人将你识别为“极差售后体验”。
result.en: The robot marks you as “unsatisfactory after-sales service”.

text.zh: 假装没看见
text.en: Run away

result.zh: 你成功逃跑，但调查表还是被无人机追着送来。
result.en: You escape, but a drone delivers the survey anyway.

description.zh: 一家餐厅推出“真正的真空低温料理”，问题是店内也没有空气。
description.en: A restaurant offers genuine vacuum cuisine. Unfortunately, there is no air.

text.zh: 我付了钱的-坚持把饭吃完
text.en: I paid for this—finish the meal

result.zh: 你创造了首位在真空中写餐厅点评的纪录。
result.en: You become the first diner to review a meal in a vacuum.

text.zh: 客户是上帝-发布差评
text.en: The customer is always right—leave a bad review

result.zh: 老板回复：“客人，您真的懂空气吗？”
result.en: The owner replies: “Do you even understand air?”

description.zh: 银河广告局宣布你的脸非常适合宣传一种尚未发明的产品。
description.en: The galactic ad agency claims your face is perfect for a product not yet invented.

text.zh: 同意拍摄
text.en: Accept the sponsorship

result.zh: 产品尚未上市，你的表情包已经破圈。
result.en: The product does not exist. Your meme already does.

text.zh: 拒绝代言
text.en: Refuse the deal

result.zh: 你错过了一次成为大明星的机会。
result.en: You have missed your chance to become a galactic superstar.

description.zh: 量子赌场声称每一次投骰都同时赢和输，但最终结果由顾客自行承担。
description.en: A quantum casino claims every roll is both a win and a loss, but customers are responsible for the final result.

text.zh: 相信量子奇迹-玩一把
text.en: Trust in quantum miracles—place a bet

result.zh: 今天概率站在你这边，赌场建议你尽快离开。
result.en: Probability favours you. The casino asks you to leave.

result.zh: 你同时输了与没输，系统只记录输了。
result.en: You simultaneously win and lose. The house only records the loss.

text.zh: 脑海中浮现出一位吐舌头的白胡子老头，他说：“上帝从不掷骰子”-离开赌场
text.en: A white-haired man sticking out his tongue appears in your mind: “God does not play dice.” Leave the casino.

result.zh: 你获得了赌场能颁发的最珍贵奖品：清醒。
result.en: You receive the casino’s rarest prize: common sense.

description.zh: 宇宙救济署随机选中了你的飞船。
description.en: The intergalactic relief agency randomly selects your ship.

result.zh: 他们给你送来充足的营养补给，附赠宣传单。
result.en: They deliver generous nutritional supplies, with a promotional leaflet thrown in.

description.zh: 一个自动售货机宣布你中了年度大奖。
description.en: A vending machine announces that you have won its annual grand prize.

result.zh: 奖品是一盒幸运筹码，机器表示不接受退货。
result.en: You receive a box of lucky tokens. No returns are accepted.

description.zh: 一段你打喷嚏的视频突然在银河系爆红。
description.en: A recording of you sneezing goes viral across the galaxy.

result.zh: 粉丝称这是最纯粹的跨物种艺术表达。
result.en: Fans call it a universal form of interspecies performance art.

description.zh: 你来到一个新的星系，当地货币以笑声作为计价单位。
description.en: You arrive in a new star system where the local currency is measured in laughter.

result.zh: 你的冷笑话变得值钱，资产配置却彻底崩溃。
result.en: Your jokes gain market value. Your financial plan does not.

description.zh: 导航设备显示今天同时是昨天和星期九。
description.en: Your navigation system reports that today is both yesterday and Fursday.

result.zh: 你花了半天修正时钟，终于确认自己还是迟到了。
result.en: After hours of repairs, you confirm that you are still late.

description.zh: 附近星系的所有居民都坚称天空中多出了一颗方形太阳。
description.en: Everyone in a nearby system insists a square sun has appeared.

result.zh: 你决定先接受这项设定，并忽略方形太阳的眨眼。
result.en: You decide to accept the premise—and ignore the square sun winking at you.

description.zh: 警报刚刚响起，一颗小行星已经撞上了飞船。
description.en: The alarm has barely sounded when an asteroid slams into your ship.

result.zh: 你活下来了，可代价是什么呢？
result.en: You survived. But at what cost?

description.zh: 航线偏差让飞船掠过黑洞的危险边缘。
description.en: A navigation error sends your ship dangerously close to a black hole.

result.zh: 你差点被拉成意大利面，可投诉时官方把这称为“免费形体管理”。
result.en: You nearly get stretched into spaghetti. When you complain, the authorities call it “complimentary body shaping.”

description.zh: 你在一张照片里把某颗星球的名字写错了一个字。
description.en: You misspell a planet’s name in a photo caption.

result.zh: 十亿网友要求你公开道歉，其中一半其实不会拼字。
result.en: A billion users demand an apology. Half cannot spell the name either.

description.zh: 附近一所实验室的实验结果突然变成了巨大的蘑菇云。
description.en: A nearby laboratory produces an unusually large mushroom cloud.

result.zh: 你获得了宝贵的第一手科学知识，以及烧焦的袖口。
result.en: You gain firsthand scientific knowledge and a scorched sleeve.

description.zh: 某学术会议误以为你是失踪的主旨演讲嘉宾。
description.en: A conference mistakes you for its missing keynote speaker.

result.zh: 你临场发言十五分钟，听众认为这是一场突破性的沉默研究。
result.en: Your improvised speech becomes a breakthrough in the study of silence.

description.zh: 你感染了一种只在周四打喷嚏的星际流感。
description.en: You catch a cosmic flu that only makes you sneeze on Thursdays.

result.zh: 医生说情况不严重，并将它命名为“疯狂星期四”。
result.en: The doctor says it is nothing serious, and names the illness “Crazy Thursday.”

description.zh: 银河边缘有一家行星孤儿院，专门收留失去母恒星的小天体。
description.en: At the edge of the galaxy stands an orphanage for planets that have lost their stars.

text.zh: 帮它们寻找愿意收养的恒星
text.en: Find a star willing to adopt them

result.zh: 一颗红矮星递来了申请表，还贴心地问孩子们怕不怕冷。
result.en: A red dwarf submits an adoption form and thoughtfully asks whether the children mind the cold.

text.zh: 支持一颗小行星的太阳梦
text.en: Support a little planet’s dream of becoming a sun

result.zh: 它感动得当场发光，院长认为你很会哄孩子。
result.en: It glows with happiness; the headteacher calls you excellent with children.

text.zh: 替孤儿院修一座环形游乐场
text.en: Build an orbital playground for the orphans

result.zh: 你陪它们绕着秋千公转了一整个下午，运动量相当可观。
result.en: You spend the afternoon orbiting the swings with them. Your fitness tracker files a formal complaint.

description.zh: 你抵达的恒星系正庆祝一年一度的午睡节。当地太阳宣布今天不营业，所有阴影暂时由市政厅人工发放。
description.en: You arrive during the annual Galactic Nap Holiday. The local sun has taken the day off, and the city council is issuing shadows by hand.

text.zh: 尊重传统，睡到自然醒
text.en: Respect tradition and sleep until you wake

result.zh: 你终于睡了个好觉，醒来时太阳仍在申请延长假期。
result.en: You get a proper night’s sleep. The sun is still negotiating for an extra day off.

text.zh: 研究太阳究竟请了什么假
text.en: Investigate the sun’s leave request

result.zh: 研究结论：恒星也会倦怠。你把论文投给了《天体劳动关系学》。
result.en: Your conclusion: stars can burn out in more ways than one. You submit it to the Journal of Stellar Labour Relations.

text.zh: 直播自己打呼噜
text.en: Livestream your snoring

result.zh: 观众评价这是最有生命力的沉浸式行为艺术。
result.en: Viewers hail your snoring as the most authentic immersive performance of the century.

description.zh: 一颗彗星刹在你的舷窗外，递来一只没有寄件人的包裹。收件人一栏写着：“某个人”。
description.en: A comet brakes outside your window and delivers a parcel with no sender. The recipient field reads: “You-know-who.”

text.zh: 既然写了名字，就签收吧
text.en: Your name is on it. Sign for it

result.zh: 箱子里装着一盒过期前还有几百万年的好运。
result.en: Inside is a box of good luck, with several million years left before its expiry date.

text.zh: 退回寄件人，并认真写明理由
text.en: Return to sender with a detailed explanation

result.zh: 你写了十七页退货说明。快递员第一次见到比宇宙说明书还啰嗦的东西。
result.en: Your return form runs to seventeen pages. The courier has never encountered anything longer-winded than the Cosmic Manual.

text.zh: 拆开再封上，赌它没人发现
text.en: Open it and reseal it. Who would notice?

result.zh: 你赌对了。盒子里还有一张写着“请继续保持侥幸心理”的纸条。
result.en: You get away with it. There is even a note inside: “Please continue making terrible decisions.”

result.zh: 万万没想到包裹有自我意识。它当场在快递群里曝光了你。
result.en: The parcel turns out to be sentient. It immediately reports you to the entire courier network.

description.zh: 一片海洋悬在两颗行星之间，鱼群向上游，水母向下落。
description.en: An entire ocean floats between two planets. Fish swim upwards and jellyfish fall downwards.

text.zh: 跳进去痛快游一圈
text.en: Go for a proper swim

result.zh: 你游得很开心，虽然花了半小时才找回“上”在哪里。
result.en: It is wonderful exercise, though it takes half an hour to rediscover which direction is up.

text.zh: 向鱼群讲解重力理论
text.en: Explain gravity to the fish

result.zh: 鱼群表示不接受审稿。
result.en: The fish reject your paper without peer review.

text.zh: 摆出经典泳姿，接受采访
text.en: Strike a heroic pose for the cameras

result.zh: 你的照片登上了星际旅游首页。拍摄团队没有提醒你头顶正漂着一只水母。
result.en: Your photo makes the cover of the Galactic Travel Guide. Nobody mentions the jellyfish above your head.

description.zh: 几颗脉冲星组成了业余合唱团，节拍精确到纳秒，它们邀请你加入。
description.en: A few pulsars have formed an amateur choir, keeping time to the nanosecond. They invite you to join.

text.zh: 不管会不会唱，先上台再说
text.en: Sing first. Worry about talent later

result.zh: 你成功成为了合唱团唯一走调的天体，获得了空前的关注。
result.en: You become the choir’s only member capable of singing off-key. The attention is unprecedented.

text.zh: 计算所有音符的频率
text.en: Calculate every note’s frequency

result.zh: 你证明了它们演奏的是一段尚未被发现的宇宙背景辐射。
result.en: You prove that the composition is actually a previously undiscovered form of cosmic background radiation.

text.zh: 站在最后一排跟着摇摆
text.en: Sway along in the back row

result.zh: 你没有唱出一个音，却获得了一个极其治愈的下午。
result.en: You do not sing a single note, but you leave feeling considerably more alive.

description.zh: 一名星际旅人突然拦住你，声称自己从未输过。他坚持要和你一决高下，比赛项目却由你决定。
description.en: An interstellar traveller blocks your path, claiming never to have lost a contest. He insists on a duel and generously lets you choose the sport.

text.zh: 比掰手腕
text.en: Challenge him to arm wrestling

result.zh: 你们掰断了三张桌子，没人记得是谁先赢的。
result.en: You break three tables. Nobody remembers who won.

text.zh: 比谁能背出更多圆周率
text.en: Compete at reciting digits of pi

result.zh: 你背到小数点后第两千位。他说自己是倒着背的，比赛因此被迫中止。
result.en: You reach the two-thousandth digit. He said he was reciting backwards and the competition had to be stopped as a result.

text.zh: 比谁先开口说话
text.en: Hold a contest of silence

result.zh: 你们互相瞪了六个小时。对方终于认输，因为他的母星快到站了。
result.en: You stare at each other for six hours. He finally surrenders because his home planet is about to pass by.

description.zh: 通讯器捕捉到一条来自未知星系的求救信号：“我们把自己的星球弄丢了。”第二条消息补充：“请不要告诉我们的母星。”
description.en: Your receiver picks up a distress signal from an uncharted galaxy: “We have misplaced our planet.” A second message adds: “Please don’t tell our parent star.”

text.zh: 亲自赶去搜救
text.en: Go there and join the search

result.zh: 你找回了那颗走失的行星。它只是躲在一片星云后面闹别扭。
result.en: You find the missing planet sulking behind a nebula. It comes home after a little encouragement.

result.zh: 你在导航途中迷失方向。失踪名单上的名字于是多了一个。
result.en: You get lost on the way. The missing-person register now has an additional entry.

text.zh: 远程分析引力数据
text.en: Analyse the gravitational data remotely

result.zh: 你确定行星没有消失，只是有人把坐标的正负号写反了。
result.en: You discover the planet never vanished. Somebody entered the wrong sign in the coordinates.

text.zh: 寄去一张星图和一封鼓励信
text.en: Send a star chart and an encouraging letter

result.zh: 对方回复：“谢谢！我们现在至少知道自己丢在哪了。”
result.en: They reply: “Thank you! At least we now know where we lost it.”

description.zh: 维修站告诉你，飞船的每一个零件都已被替换。工作人员问：“所以它还是原来的飞船吗？”
description.en: The repair station has replaced every part of your ship. “Is it still the same ship?”

text.zh: 从哲学角度认真回答
text.en: Give a rigorous philosophical answer

result.zh: 你写了八页论证。维修工只问你要不要买延保。
result.en: You produce eight pages of reasoning. The mechanic asks whether you would like an extended warranty.

text.zh: 给飞船起一个新名字
text.en: Give the ship a completely new name

result.zh: 新名字在当地社交媒体上爆红。飞船本人倒没发表意见。
result.en: The new name goes viral. The ship itself declines to comment.

text.zh: 用旧零件再拼一艘
text.en: Build another ship from the old parts

result.zh: 你拥有了两艘飞船，外加两倍的维护成本。好消息是至少有一艘能睡觉。
result.en: You now own two ships and twice the maintenance bills. On the bright side, one has somewhere comfortable to sleep.

description.zh: 你在舱壁上发现一个贴着“静音”的按钮。按下后，真空终于安静了下来。你不确定这有没有实际意义。
description.en: You find a button labelled MUTE on the cabin wall. Pressing it makes the vacuum even quieter. You are unsure what this accomplishes.

text.zh: 继续按，记录宇宙反应
text.en: Keep pressing and record the results

result.zh: 你写出了一份关于“静音对真空影响为零”的出色科幻小说。
result.en: You produce an excellent science fiction demonstrating that muting a vacuum has precisely no measurable effect.

text.zh: 安安静静享受片刻
text.en: Enjoy the peace and quiet

result.zh: 这是七天以来最安宁的五分钟。直到宇宙重启提示音响起。
result.en: It is the most peaceful five minutes of your journey, right up until the universe plays its startup sound.

text.zh: 把静音键当麦克风开演唱会
text.en: Treat the button as a microphone and give a concert

result.zh: 宇宙没有听见，直播间里的观众却给你刷了很多礼物。
result.en: The universe hears nothing. Your livestream audience, however, sends plenty of gifts.

description.zh: 一间小书店出售尚未写成的自传。店主把你的那本放到柜台上，封面写着：“作者本人尚不知情”。
description.en: A tiny bookshop sells autobiographies that have not yet been written. Yours is waiting on the counter, subtitled: “The Author Has Not Been Informed.”

text.zh: 直接偷看最后一页
text.en: Skip straight to the last page

result.zh: 最后一页只有一句话：“请勿相信最后一页。”你感觉这书很会做生意。
result.en: The last page says only: “Do not trust the last page.” You admire the publisher’s business model.

text.zh: 检查作者、版本和出版时间
text.en: Check the author, edition and publication date

result.zh: 书的出版时间是后天，但退货期限已经过去。至少你研究出了时间悖论的基本结构。
result.en: The book comes out the day after tomorrow, but its return window has already closed. You learn a great deal about temporal paradoxes.

text.zh: 替邻座陌生人的自传写序
text.en: Write a foreword for a stranger’s life story

result.zh: 对方读完很感动，虽然你写的第一句是“我并不认识此人”。
result.en: They are deeply moved, despite your opening line: “I have never met this person.”

description.zh: 一颗超新星突然开始倒放爆炸。碎片正往恒星内部飞回去，天文学家的论文也在一页页变白。
description.en: A supernova abruptly begins exploding in reverse. Debris rushes back into the star, and astronomers watch their published papers turn blank.

text.zh: 冲进爆炸中心，试试时间倒流
text.en: Fly into the blast and try reversing time

result.zh: 你从一场尚未发生的爆炸里完好归来，还顺便捡回了几年前丢掉的体力。
result.en: You return unharmed from an explosion that has not happened yet, and somehow recover years of lost stamina.

result.zh: 你把自己折进了时间轴的夹缝里。出来时连疼痛都比你早到三分钟。
result.en: You get folded into a crease in the timeline. Your pain arrives three minutes before you do.

text.zh: 撤离并把观测数据带走
text.en: Retreat with the observation data

result.zh: 你逃得比光还快——至少事故报告是这么写的。
result.en: You escape faster than light, or so the incident report claims.

text.zh: 打开直播，标题写“宇宙正在撤回消息”
text.en: Livestream it: “The Universe Is Unsending a Message”

result.zh: 你火了，但评论区开始争论爆炸究竟算不算剧透。
result.en: You go viral. The comment section debates whether an explosion in reverse counts as a spoiler.

description.zh: 你在一颗没有夜晚的行星登陆。当地居民温馨提示：这里的土地会吃掉影子，。
description.en: You land on a planet with no nighttime. The locals warn you that the ground eats shadows.

text.zh: 把自己的影子抢回来
text.en: Wrestle your shadow back

result.zh: 你赢了，影子却坚称自己只是暂时休假。
result.en: You win, although your shadow claims it was merely taking a short holiday.

text.zh: 试着解释影子不是食物
text.en: Explain that shadows are not edible

result.zh: 你给出了一套精彩的光学论证。大地礼貌地吃掉了最后一页。
result.en: You deliver a brilliant lecture on optics. The ground politely eats the final page of your notes.

text.zh: 把影子留给它，自己去晒太阳
text.en: Leave the shadow behind and catch some sun

result.zh: 你忽然轻松了许多。医生说这是因为终于不用背负自己的阴影。
result.en: You feel strangely lighter. The doctor attributes it to no longer carrying your own shadow.

description.zh: 一头与星云一样大的鲸鱼从你的航路上游过，打了个喷嚏。三颗卫星因此下起了雨，气象台坚持称这是局部阵雨。
description.en: A whale the size of a nebula swims across your route and sneezes. Rain begins falling on three moons. The weather service calls it “isolated showers”.

text.zh: 撑起护盾，替附近的小飞船挡一挡
text.en: Raise your shield to protect nearby ships

result.zh: 你挡住了冲击波，还收到了来自七个星系的感谢信。
result.en: You hold back the shock wave and receive thank-you notes from seven star systems.

result.zh: 护盾一秒就碎了。好在你的飞船现在被免费清洗得很彻底。
result.en: Your shield shatters in a second. On the bright side, your ship has never been cleaner.

text.zh: 立即驶进最近的陨石阴影
text.en: Take cover behind the nearest asteroid

result.zh: 你平安躲过喷嚏，顺便完成了一次天然的水疗。
result.en: You avoid the blast and enjoy an unexpected spa treatment.

text.zh: 拍下来，配文“宇宙过敏季来了”
text.en: Post the footage: “Cosmic Allergy Season Is Here”

result.zh: 鲸鱼突然有了自己的粉丝后援会。你成了第一位被鲸鱼认证的娱乐记者。
result.en: The whale acquires an enormous fan club. You become the first entertainment reporter officially endorsed by a whale.

description.zh: 你被随机选中参加一项免费体检。扫描仪称你缺乏叶绿素，医生只好承认机器把你误判成了盆栽。
description.en: You are randomly selected for a free health check. The scanner reports a chlorophyll deficiency. The doctor admits it has mistaken you for a houseplant.

result.zh: 诊所补偿了一大包营养补给，还附赠《常见盆栽护理手册》。你决定先留着。
result.en: The clinic compensates you with a generous supply of nutrients and a booklet on houseplant care. You decide to keep both.

description.zh: 星际天文台宣布找回了一个被日历遗漏的星期八。所有人被要求自行决定该如何使用这一天。
description.en: The Interstellar Observatory announces the recovery of an eighth weekday lost from the calendar. Everyone may spend it however they wish.

result.zh: 你把额外的时间全部拿来休息。宇宙没有意见，甚至还帮你关了闹钟。
result.en: You spend the extra time resting. The universe raises no objections and even turns off your alarm.

title.en: A Random Compliment from the Cosmos

description.zh: 银河公共频道突然宣布，你被评为“年度最值得鼓掌的路人”。你连报名表都没填过。
description.en: The galaxy-wide public channel announces that you have won “Most Applause-Worthy Passer-by of the Year”. You never even entered.

result.zh: 周围的星球开始鼓掌。你以为这只是广播特效，直到你的飞船也拍起了手。
result.en: Nearby planets begin applauding. You assume it is a broadcast effect, until your ship starts clapping too.

description.zh: 宇宙所有频道突然播出红色警报：“预计三十秒后全面坍缩。”你刚准备写遗言，警报就被撤回了。
description.en: Every channel in the universe flashes a red alert: “Total collapse in thirty seconds.” Just as you begin drafting your last words, the announcement is withdrawn.

result.zh: 官方解释是有人把烤面包机接进了宇宙预警系统。你庆幸地松了口气，并开始怀疑这个宇宙的运维水平。
result.en: Officials explain that someone connected a toaster to the universal warning system. You are relieved, though your confidence in cosmic maintenance has suffered.

description.zh: 星际翻译系统发生故障，把每一句“祝你好运”都翻译成了“我要求单挑”。外交部门已经忙了八个小时。
description.en: The galactic translation network malfunctions, rendering every “Good luck” as “I challenge you to a duel.” Diplomats have been busy for eight hours.

result.zh: 你编写了一份紧急词典。问题得到解决，但仍有人坚持觉得单挑比较有诚意。
result.en: You compile an emergency phrasebook. The crisis passes, though some civilisations still consider a duel the sincerest form of encouragement.

description.zh: 银河平均气温异常上升，各地恒星纷纷否认自己调高了温度。你飞船里的冰箱率先宣布罢工。
description.en: The galaxy is experiencing an alarming rise in temperature. Every star denies turning up the heat. Your ship’s refrigerator goes on strike.

result.zh: 你靠着最后一块冰坚持了一整天。它最终融化时，舱内举行了简短而庄严的告别仪式。
result.en: You survive the day with one last ice cube. When it finally melts, the crew holds a brief but dignified memorial service.

title.en: Breakfast of the Black Hole God

description.zh: 持续升高的银河气温唤醒了一尊沉睡千万年的古神。祂的本体是一颗黑洞，醒来第一句话是：“有什么吃的吗？”随后开始吞噬沿途星系的质量。
description.en: Rising galactic temperatures awaken an ancient god after millions of years asleep. Its true form is a black hole. Its first words are, “Is there anything to eat?” It begins devouring the mass of neighbouring star systems.

result.zh: 祂吃掉了三团星云，对你的飞船却只咬了一小口，评价是“热量太低”。你活了下来，但不确定该不该感到荣幸。
result.en: After swallowing three nebulae, it takes one bite of your ship and declares it “too low in calories”. You survive, uncertain whether to feel honoured.
